name: Souma Eimi
source:
A junior of Mari, she studies to become a veterinary medicine researcher. 

A person whose shyness exceeds Mari's, she has few friends at her school. She's only attached to her childhood friend who is her boyfriend at the same time, and Mari, who she thinks is cheerful and sociable. 

Their family breed large dogs, and thus she's somewhat used to dogs, but when it comes to other animals, she's a bit scared, though she can somehow cope with it. 

She's quite uncomfortable when it comes to sexual matters, and as a result, she hasn't even kissed her boyfriend yet, and has a poor sexual knowledge. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyclet/cyclet_main.html]Official Site[/url]]
